text:
ben: heads up — hit an odd edge case with the embeddings endpoint. mixed-dim vectors in the same batch are getting routed to a fallback shard and we blow tenant quota unpredictably. repro below.

ben: sample payload we sent:
```json
{"model":"text-embed-3-large","input":["short text","longer text..."],"dims":[1536,2048]}
```

ben: preflight treats the whole batch as max-dim (2048) then split plan sent to shard-B; shard-B rejects due to quota even though combined token counts looked fine for shard-A.

mira: ugh. can you paste the router log snippet? which route keys were computed? :eyes:

ben: log snippet:
```
ROUTER INFO: request_id=abc123 tenant=acme dims=[1536,2048] prefer_shard=shard-A
ROUTER DEBUG: dim_mismatch -> compute_split_plan -> plan=[{shard: A, dims:1536, items:[0]},{shard:B, dims:2048, items:[1]}]
QUOTA ERROR: shard=B tenant=acme quota_exceeded units_needed=1200
```

sam: our router assumes uniform dims per RPC. mixed-dim support wasn't a first-class case. we either (a) reject early (400) or (b) auto-split w/ clear units estimate. current silent split + fallback is the worst UX.

mira: agree. UX ask: should console show a preflight estimate (units + split plan) for batched embeddings? that would surface surprise charges/quotas.

devex: +1. If SDK can call a preflight endpoint or send `X-Embed-Preflight: true` header we could warn users before sending big mixed batches.

ria: SRE note: auto-splitting increases request fanout and can overload small tenants if many small splits happen. we need a circuit-breaker: soft-fail (413) when projected extra units > threshold, and a metric for split-related overloads.

alex: proposal (short-term): add explicit preflight endpoint that returns `units_estimate` and `split_plan`. patch router to 1) reject mixed-dim unsafely split when tenant quota risk detected 2) emit metric `embed.mixed_dims.split_rate`. long-term: bucket routing by dim families so mixed batches can be coalesced server-side w/ padding or batch-by-dim.

ben: I can open an RFC with the tradeoffs. for immediate telemetry: add `embed.mixed_dims.split_rate` and `embed.preflight.units_estimate` tags to traces. also add a console tile showing recent split failures and estimated cost delta.

infra-bot: deploy queued: router/mixed-dim-preflight-metrics -> canary today 11:30 PT. CI green. :shipit:

mira: can we also add a per-request flag in logs `embed_split: auto|preflight|reject` so the quota dashboard can group by behavior?

ben: yes — will include `embed_split=auto` for split requests and `embed_preflight=true` for preflight calls.

devex: SDK note: I'll add a small client-side helper that 1) calls preflight when mixed dims detected 2) surfaces a console warning with estimated units and suggested split. PR coming.

sam: docs update required: embeddings API contract should call out mixed-dim semantics + recommended patterns (send as separate requests, pad to uniform dim, or use preflight). also add sample code.

ria: operational action: add alert if `embed.mixed_dims.split_rate` exceeds 0.5% of embedding QPS and split_reject_count > 5/min for a tenant.

mira: thanks. next steps: ben files RFC (#4123), ben opens router PR for metrics + safe-reject, devex opens SDK PR, docs PR from sam. we'll reconvene after canary results. :+1:

ben: filing RFC + issue now: https://go/repo/rfcs/4123 (WIP). tagging people for follow-ups.

mira: awesome — keep me posted.

ben: closing loop — will add a short console mock for preflight tile before next sync.

alex: TL;DR: mixed-dim batches are allowed today but routing fallback + silent split can cause quota surprises. preflight + clear console telemetry + short-term safe-reject policy is the path forward. :white_check_mark:
